description: This file defines a custom XAML state trigger class 'ControlSizeTrigger' that activates based on the size of a specified control, with properties for minimum height and width.

classes.name: ControlSizeTrigger
classes.description: A custom XAML StateTrigger that activates based on the size of a specified FrameworkElement, with configurable minimum height and width.

methods.name: ControlSizeTrigger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trigger and sets it to inactive.

methods.name: OnSourcePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the Source property, updating event subscriptions accordingly.

methods.name: RegisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Registers the SizeChanged event handler for the specified FrameworkElement.

methods.name: UnregisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Unregisters the SizeChanged event handler from the specified FrameworkElement.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the size of the source element changes, updating the trigger's active state.

methods.name: UpdateIsActive
methods.description: Determines whether the trigger should be active based on the current size and the MinHeight and MinWidth properties.
